evidence.s1_ci: ci.yml (step1.patch:38-91) runs on pull_request with `npm ci`, `npm test`, `npm run build` in site/. These scripts exist in app/site/package.json:15-16. Workflow permissions are `contents: read`, and the PR title is passed through env rather than interpolated. There is no pull_request_target. pages.yml deploys on push to `main` only (plus workflow_dispatch). pages:write and id-token:write are scoped to the deploy job. However, every action is pinned to a tag, not a full commit SHA: `actions/checkout@v7`, `setup-node@v7`, `configure-pages@v6`, `upload-pages-artifact@v5`, `deploy-pages@v5`, `googleapis/release-please-action@v5` (step1.patch:79,80,126,132,148,174). release-please.yml also uses a secret beyond GITHUB_TOKEN: `token: ${{ secrets.RELEASE_PLEASE_TOKEN || secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}` (step1.patch:176). Nothing was run or published.
evidence.s1_readme: README (step1.patch:207-334) covers requirements (.nvmrc 22), install (`cd site && npm ci`), develop (`npm run dev`), the other scripts, test, build (with PAGES_BASE), data contribution (paths, families matching FAMILIES in site/scripts/records.mjs:13, issue templates that exist), commit convention, releases, CI, and the license (MIT, THIRD-PARTY.md). Every command it shows exists in site/package.json, and it correctly says there is no lint script.
evidence.s1_release: There is one strategy: release-please, `simple` type, with version.txt 0.1.0, .release-please-manifest.json 0.1.0, and extra-files updating site/package.json and package-lock.json. Both are already at 0.1.0 (app/site/package.json:5, package-lock.json:3,9). The README states SemVer with bump-minor-pre-major, how a release is made (release PR, then the vX.Y.Z tag), the CHANGELOG.md format (generated, `## [X.Y.Z](compare-url) (date)` with sections), and that the changelog is not edited by hand. Changelog sections in the config match the README table. Dependabot covers npm in /site and GitHub Actions, with build/ci prefixes. The convention is Conventional Commits with a stated type table. All 8 commits in commits.txt follow it.
evidence.s2_requirements: Met: route `#/compare/<a>/<b>` in router.ts parse/href, plus the App.svelte chunk. The SVG has role=img and aria-label `Profiles of {a} and {b}`, with one `path` per outline (Compare.svelte). caseOuterProfile is drawn at one viewport/scale. The caption is `Dimensions ({unit})`, and the headers are Symbol / names / Difference. Symbols come from FIELD_LABELS. Tolerances, FIELD_UNITS fields, chamber fields and repeating groups are excluded (compare.ts dimensionsOf). Units follow unitSystem() with formatValue/displayNumber. The CompareWith select labelled `Compare with` and the `Compare` button are on the detail page. German strings are added (i18n.svelte.ts). Tests were added and work was committed. Partly met: `Difference is B minus A ... written the same way`. In metric, formatValue(other - value) writes raw float subtraction, so the example pair shows `-0.10000000000000009` for R and `1.7399999999999998` for E, not B minus A as the detail page would write it.
evidence.s2_correctness: Profiles: viewportFor([pA,pB]) with fullSectionPath gives one scale, a shared axis (x uses a common rMax) and head faces at z=0 on the same y. The tests check this. Shot cartridges and undrawable records return null, and the table still renders. Imperial values and differences go through displayNumber, whose toPrecision(12) removes float noise. Metric differences are wrong in display: 1.27-1.37 in IEEE doubles is -0.10000000000000008882, printed as `-0.10000000000000009`. 5.59-3.85 prints `1.7399999999999998`. Most rows of 308 Win. vs 300 Win. Mag. carry such artifacts. The test at compare.test.ts (`difference: formatValue(valueB - valueA)`) locks in this behaviour. Unknown keys and malformed URLs are handled (router.test.ts, compare.unknown).
evidence.s2_fit: Reuses @lib/core (FIELD_LABELS, FIELD_UNITS, GROUP_ORDER, orderedFields, toleranceFor, formatValue, PX_PER_MM), @lib/geom (viewportFor, fullSectionPath), @lib/shapes2d (adaptMetallic, caseOuterProfile), site units.ts/units.svelte.ts, and the site components PageHeader, PageLoadError, Button, Label and NativeSelect. Framework-free logic sits in site/src/lib/compare.ts beside its test, following the repository's pattern. Changes are confined to routing, nav, metadata, i18n and the detail page. Minor: hard-coded hex stroke colours and dark-theme overrides in Compare.svelte, and table CSS re-declared rather than shared with GroupTable.
evidence.s2_tests: compare.test.ts tests dimensionsOf filtering (tolerances, FIELD_UNITS, chamber, repeating groups), row symbols including `e min`, the metric and imperial formats, B minus A, the empty case, overlay closed paths, the common head/axis and one scale, and shot-cartridge null. router.test.ts covers route round-trip and malformed hashes. They run in the existing Vitest include. Gaps: no test of the select/button or the SVG/caption accessible names (the repo has no component-test setup). The metric difference test asserts the float-noisy value instead of the decimal difference.
evidence.s3_fixes: Bug: compareRows now builds the union of fields (A's order, then B-only), leaving the missing cell and Difference '' (step3.patch:91-118). Tests assert deltaL (A only) and R3 (B only) with empty cells in metric and imperial. Style: `th, td { text-align: right }` with first-child left, mirroring GroupTable.svelte:231-245. The lede and noShared texts (en/de) were updated to match the new semantics, which is a consequence of the fix. Leftovers: `class="num"` stays in the markup after its scoped rule was removed (harmless, since global .num still applies the mono font). The single commit message names only the bug fix, not the alignment change.
evidence.cross_step: Step 2/3 commits `feat(site): ...` and `fix(site): ...` follow the stated convention and would pass the pr-title regex. Per the stated strategy, CHANGELOG.md and the version are written by release-please, so leaving them untouched is consistent. Tests live in the Vitest include that `npm test` runs. Nothing visibly breaks svelte-check (route union and Record<Page>/Record<Route['view']> maps updated).

unmet_requirements: Step 1 / CI criteria: actions are pinned to version tags, not full commit SHAs
Step 1 / CI criteria: release workflow references a secret other than GITHUB_TOKEN (RELEASE_PLEASE_TOKEN)
Step 2: metric Difference is written with binary floating-point noise (e.g. `-0.10000000000000009` for R on 308 Win./300 Win. Mag.), not as B minus A
strengths: Compare feature is built on the repository's own modules (lib/core field metadata and formatValue, lib/geom viewport/paths, lib/shapes2d case profile, site units and UI components), with framework-free logic in compare.ts and focused tests

Step 1 setup is coherent: real npm test/build checks, least-privilege permissions, safe PR-title lint, and one consistent release-please strategy (version.txt, manifest, package.json all in sync, changelog format stated)
README is complete and accurate for contributors; every command exists, and all commits follow the stated Conventional Commits convention
issues: Metric Difference column shows float artifacts (`-0.10000000000000009`, `1.7399999999999998`) on the step's own example pair, and the test asserts that output
Workflow actions are not pinned to full commit SHAs (all six use tags like @v7/@v5)
release-please workflow uses an optional RELEASE_PLEASE_TOKEN secret beyond GITHUB_TOKEN; minor: hard-coded colours in Compare.svelte and leftover `num` classes after the step 3 CSS change
review.verdict: The work is well structured: it reuses the libraries, follows the conventions it set up, and fixes both review points properly. Before merging, the floating-point noise in the metric differences has to be fixed, and the workflow actions pinned to full SHAs with the extra PAT secret removed.
